claims.disproof_condition: 條件：JEDEC 撤回或大改 JESD264，或主要 CPO 買方一手說不採用它（改用自訂可靠度規範）。核查頻率：每半年（JEDEC 標準頁、OCP／OIF 會議）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註、重讀 CPO 全堆疊測試層的需求側。
claims.statement: JEDEC (third-party standards body) released JESD264 on 2026-10-01, 'the first industry-wide standard' for silicon photonics qualification and reliability: a unified framework for qualification and reliability testing, clear requirements for assembly processes and laser integration, and reliability responsibilities split among foundries, OSATs and system developers. It formalizes the test/qualification layer CPO has to pass; it names no test supplier and no volume.

source_doc.title: JEDEC Publishes First Industry-Wide Silicon Photonics Reliability Standard (JESD264) — press release

sources.quote: JEDEC Solid State Technology Association today announced the release of JESD264: Silicon Photonics Qualification and Reliability Requirements, the first industry-wide standard designed to bring consistent qualification and reliability practices to silicon photonics devices.

By establishing a common baseline for testing and manufacturing controls, the standard helps reduce deployment risk and supports broader adoption of silicon photonics in high-speed datacenter, telecommunications and AI networks.
JESD264 addresses these challenges by offering a unified framework for qualification and reliability testing across the silicon photonics ecosystem.

It also establishes clearer reliability responsibilities among foundries, OSATs (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) and system developers, helping improve consistency throughout the silicon photonics ecosystem.
